name: 90019 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90019 (Los Angeles) has 321 nonprofit organizations. 98 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 80 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90019 (Los Angeles) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90019 (Los Angeles) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 49 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
